remarks: Step into this light and bright condo at the highly desirable Wilton Crest complex, and prepare to be wowed. The first thing that draws you in is the gorgeous water view of the pond, which is visible from the living room, dining room, kitchen and both bedrooms. You'll love cooking in the beautifully appointed kitchen with granite counters, white cabinets, stainless appliances, and pantry. The dining room, open to the kitchen, also makes a nice work from home spot - taking in those views, takes the stress away. The living room with fireplace has a slider to a balcony overlooking the pond. And a large private deck, just off the kitchen, offers a great space for al fresco dining. Upstairs are two ensuite bedrooms. The primary has a walk-in closet, & bathroom w/shower & jacuzzi tub. The second bedroom has a bathroom with a tub/shower. You'll love the conveniences of laundry on the first level and an attached 1 car garage with access right into the unit on the lower level. There's also a cozy family room and office in the lower level. You'll love the outdoor pool & tennis court (open from Memorial Day through Labor Day), as well as the location, just a short walk to restaurants, movie theaters, hiking trails, shops and the town library. The award winning Wilton schools are a short drive away. Don't miss out on seeing this gem today!
